title: Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge
summary: High Treasury yields above 5% are increasing borrowing costs for both households and the federal government, compounding the challenge of financing $2 trillion annual deficits. This combination threatens long-term fiscal sustainability and is emerging as a critical economic headwind.
content: Treasury yields above 5% are raising borrowing costs for households and the federal government, highlighting the challenge of financing $2 trillion deficits.

zh.title: 分析：为什么2万亿美元赤字和5%的国债收益率正成为美国最大的经济挑战
zh.summary: 超过5%的国债收益率正在增加家庭和联邦政府的借贷成本，加剧了融资2万亿美元年度赤字的挑战。这一组合威胁到长期财政可持续性，并成为一个关键的经济逆风。

title: CoreWeave shares are sinking. Buy the dip, Deutsche Bank says
summary: Cloud infrastructure company CoreWeave's stock has been declining, but Deutsche Bank maintains a buy rating, seeing the weakness as a buying opportunity. The investment bank's positive outlook suggests confidence in the company's long-term prospects.
content: The investment bank has a buy on the cloud infrastructure stock.

zh.title: CoreWeave股价下跌。德意志银行表示应该抄底
zh.summary: 云基础设施公司CoreWeave的股票一直在下跌，但德意志银行维持买入评级，将这次下跌视为买入机会。这家投资银行的积极前景表明对该公司长期前景的信心。

title: U.S. reportedly considers use of 'mother of all bombs' as Iran vows to fight on
summary: The U.S. military has developed strike options against Iran including potential use of one of the world's largest non-nuclear weapons, amid escalating tensions. Iran has signaled its willingness to continue confrontation despite the threat.
content: The U.S. military has reportedly drawn up options for strikes on Iran that include the potential use of one of the biggest non-nuclear bombs in its arsenal.

zh.title: 美国据报考虑使用"炸弹之母"，伊朗发誓继续对抗
zh.summary: 在局势升级的背景下，美国军方已制定了针对伊朗的打击方案，包括可能使用世界上最大的非核武器之一。伊朗已表示尽管面临威胁，仍愿意继续对抗。

title: Ukraine to resume strikes on Russian refineries, shattering hopes of an 'energy ceasefire'
summary: Ukraine is ending its pause on attacks against Russian energy infrastructure after Moscow failed to reciprocate in a proposed energy truce brokered by Trump. The resumption escalates the conflict and undermines ceasefire efforts.
content: Ukraine will now resume attacks on Russian energy targets after Moscow hasn't held up its end of the proposed deal brokered by Trump.

zh.title: 乌克兰恢复对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击，打破"能源停火"的希望
zh.summary: 在莫斯科未能在特朗普斡旋的能源休兵协议中得到回应后，乌克兰结束了对俄罗斯能源基础设施的暂停攻击。恢复攻击升级了冲突并破坏了停火努力。

title: France is ‘putting the house in order’ and can slash deficit to 3% in three years, central bank governor tells CNBC
summary: France's central bank governor says the country can reduce its deficit to 3% within three years through disciplined fiscal measures. The announcement provides reassurance to investors concerned about Europe's fiscal stability.
content: France is able to slash its huge budget deficit troubling investors across the globe, according to the head of the country's central bank.

zh.title: 法国"整顿财政"，央行行长告诉CNBC三年内可将赤字削减至3%
zh.summary: 法国央行行长表示，通过严格的财政措施，该国可在三年内将赤字降低到3%。该公告为担心欧洲财政稳定性的投资者提供了保证。

title: What to know about Starshield, SpaceX's military-focused Starlink service
summary: SpaceX's Starshield is a separate military-oriented version of its Starlink satellite internet service, designed to meet defense department requirements. Unlike the commercial Starlink, Starshield is restricted from offensive military operations.
content: Elon Musk distinguished Starshield from Starlink, which he said could not be used for offensive military operations.

zh.title: 关于星盾（Starshield）的须知——SpaceX的军事应用Starlink服务
zh.summary: SpaceX的星盾（Starshield）是其Starlink卫星互联网服务的独立军事版本，旨在满足国防部的需求。与商业Starlink不同，星盾被限制用于进攻性军事行动。

title: Healey says surprise UK growth is 'sign of resilience' ahead of Budget
summary: The UK economy expanded 0.1% in August, surpassing analyst expectations of a potential contraction and signaling economic resilience. The unexpected growth comes as the government prepares its upcoming budget announcement.
content: The economy grew by 0.1% in August, defying analysts' expectations of a slight contraction.

zh.title: 希利称英国增长意外是预算前的"韧性迹象"
zh.summary: 英国经济在8月份扩张了0.1%，超过了分析师对可能收缩的预期，显示经济韧性。这一意外增长出现在政府准备推出预算公告之际。

title: I’m 64 years old, with two sons, but only one works in the family firm. Should I leave him 70% of the business?
summary: A business owner seeks advice on wealth succession planning, specifically whether to allocate 70% of the family business to his son who is actively involved. The dilemma highlights tensions between rewarding active participation and fairness to uninvolved heirs.
content: “I have some reservations about the long-term stability of my younger son’s marriage.”

zh.title: 我64岁，有两个儿子，但只有一个在家族企业工作。我应该给他留70%的企业吗？
zh.summary: 一位企业主寻求关于财富继承规划的建议，特别是是否应该将70%的家族企业分配给积极参与的儿子。这个困境突出了奖励主动参与者与对不参与继承人公平对待之间的矛盾。

title: China indicates rare earths will keep flowing to EU, regardless of U.S. trade deal expiration
summary: China has signaled it will continue exporting rare earths to the European Union independent of U.S. trade negotiations, following talks between EU and Chinese officials. The message suggests China is maintaining strategic supply relationships with Europe despite broader trade tensions.
content: European trade commissioner Maroš Sefčovič met with Chinese Commerce Minister Wang Wentao in Beijing last week.

zh.title: 中国表示无论美国贸易协议到期与否，稀土将继续流向欧盟
zh.summary: 中国表示将继续向欧盟出口稀土，独立于美国贸易谈判，这是在欧盟和中国官员谈话之后。这传递的信息是中国正在维持与欧洲的战略供应关系，尽管存在更广泛的贸易紧张局势。

title: ‘New Girl’ star Jake Johnson lists lush and private Pasadena estate for $3.3 million
summary: Actor Jake Johnson is selling his Pasadena property, a four-bedroom home spanning 3,153 square feet offering privacy and luxury amenities. The $3.3 million listing reflects strong Southern California real estate values for high-profile properties.
content: Jake Johnson is looking to sell his four-bedroom, four-bathroom Southern California property, which offers approximately 3,153 square feet of living space.

zh.title: 《新女孩》明星杰克·约翰逊以330万美元出售帕萨迪纳豪宅
zh.summary: 演员杰克·约翰逊正在出售其帕萨迪纳房产，这是一栋四居室住宅，建筑面积3153平方英尺，提供隐私和豪华便利设施。330万美元的挂牌价反映了南加州高档房产的强劲房地产价值。

title: Why the AI trade is not set up for a rebound like July’s, according to JPMorgan
summary: JPMorgan strategists argue that AI stocks lack the structural conditions needed for a recovery similar to July's rebound, citing low short positions, ending corporate buybacks, and excessive long positions. The negative setup suggests limited upside catalyst for the sector in the near term.
content: Fewer shorts, buybacks ending,  no inflows and too many longs imply no recovery is imminent, says a JPMorgan strategist.

zh.title: 根据摩根大通，AI交易未为类似7月的反弹做好准备
zh.summary: 摩根大通策略师辩称AI股票缺乏类似7月反弹所需的结构条件，理由是空头头寸低、公司回购结束以及多头头寸过度。负面的设置表明该行业近期上升催化剂有限。

title: UK economy grew 0.1% in August, beating expectations
summary: The UK's economy exceeded analyst forecasts by growing 0.1% in August despite ongoing cost-of-living pressures from inflation and rising energy costs. The modest growth demonstrates economic resilience in challenging conditions.
content: The U.K. is grappling with a cost-of-living crisis sparked by sticky inflation and surging energy costs.

zh.title: 英国经济8月增长0.1%，超出预期
zh.summary: 尽管持续面临通胀和能源成本上升带来的生活成本压力，英国经济在8月增长0.1%，超过了分析师预测。这种温和的增长表明在困难条件下经济具有韧性。

title: TSMC CEO sees no sign of a slowdown as chip foundry reports record profit
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company reported record third-quarter profits of 763.34 billion New Taiwan Dollars, with CEO expressing confidence in continued momentum. The exceptional results reflect strong demand from the AI sector's chip requirements.
content: The semiconductor foundry announced third-quarter net profits of 763.34 Taiwanese new dollars, marking a record.

zh.title: 台积电CEO表示芯片代工业没有放缓迹象，报告创纪录利润
zh.summary: 台湾半导体制造公司(TSMC)报告第三季度创纪录利润为763.34亿新台币，首席执行官对持续增长势头表示信心。这些卓越的成果反映了人工智能领域对芯片需求的强劲拉动。

title: TSMC posts record profit for a sixth straight quarter, beating estimates on AI boom
summary: TSMC achieved record profitability for the sixth consecutive quarter, exceeding analyst expectations driven by surging AI-related chip demand. The sustained earnings growth underscores the semiconductor industry's central role in AI infrastructure expansion.
content: TSMC reported its third-quarter earnings on Thursday.

zh.title: 台积电连续第六个季度创纪录利润，在AI热潮中超越预期
zh.summary: 台积电连续第六个季度实现创纪录的盈利能力，受到激增的AI相关芯片需求的推动，超过分析师预期。持续的收益增长凸显了半导体行业在AI基础设施扩张中的核心作用。

title: India’s IDBI Bank falls 7% as government announces $5.5 billion stake sale to Canada's Fairfax
summary: India's government is selling a $5.5 billion stake in state-owned IDBI Bank to Canadian investor Fairfax, causing the bank's share price to drop 7%. The stake sale is part of the government's broader divestment strategy to fund its fiscal priorities amid economic pressures.
content: The Indian government has been divesting its stake in several state-owned companies this year as it tries to keep its growth engine running amid deepening fiscal pressures.

zh.title: 印度IDBI银行下跌7%，政府宣布向加拿大Fairfax出售55亿美元股权
zh.summary: 印度政府正在向加拿大投资者Fairfax出售国有IDBI银行的55亿美元股权，导致银行股价下跌7%。此次股权出售是政府更广泛的资产剥离战略的一部分，旨在为其在经济压力下的财政优先事项筹资。

title: Anthropic flags revenue surge to investors ahead of stock market debut
summary: Anthropic is reporting a revenue surge to investors ahead of its upcoming stock market debut. The announcement comes as investors express growing concerns about the substantial capital required for AI infrastructure development. This positions Anthropic's strong revenue growth against broader industry skepticism about AI economics.
content: It comes as some investors have become concerned about the amount of money being spent on AI infrastructure.

zh.title: Anthropic向投资者报告收入激增 为股市上市做准备
zh.summary: Anthropic向投资者报告其即将上市前的收入激增。该公告发布之际，投资者对AI基础设施开发所需的巨大资本感到日益担忧。这将Anthropic强劲的收入增长与更广泛的行业对AI经济学的怀疑对立起来。

title: Elon Musk says Trump is 'ultimately' responsible for any curbs on Ukraine's Starshield systems
summary: Elon Musk stated that any restrictions on Starshield usage for Ukraine are ultimately determined by the U.S. military and the sitting president. The clarification addresses questions about U.S. control over the satellite system and reflects the intersection of private space infrastructure with government military policy.
content: "Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS," Musk wrote.

zh.title: 埃隆·马斯克说特朗普"最终"对乌克兰星盾系统的任何限制负责
zh.summary: 埃隆·马斯克表示，对乌克兰星盾使用的任何限制最终由美国军方和现任总统决定。这一澄清解决了关于美国对卫星系统控制的问题，反映了私人太空基础设施与政府军事政策的交汇。

title: S&P 500 futures fall as traders await more U.S. economic data: Live updates
summary: S&P 500 futures declined after a market session that reacted negatively to stronger-than-expected inflation data. Traders are awaiting additional economic indicators that could influence Federal Reserve policy decisions. The decline reflects ongoing market sensitivity to inflation and interest rate expectations.
content: The moves come after a losing session on the back of hotter-than-expected U.S. inflation data.

zh.title: 标普500期货下跌 交易员等待更多美国经济数据：实时更新
zh.summary: 标普500期货在对高于预期的通胀数据作出负面反应的市场交易后下跌。交易员正在等待可能影响美联储政策决定的其他经济指标。这种下跌反映了市场对通胀和利率预期的持续敏感性。

title: Meta- and Google-backed Jio Platforms to raise up to $3.2 billion in historic IPO in India
summary: Jio Platforms, backed by Meta and Google, is preparing to raise up to $3.2 billion through an IPO that would be India's largest in rupee terms and second-largest in dollar terms. This offering underscores India's growing prominence in global capital markets and reflects strong investor confidence in the country's digital economy.
content: Jio's share sale will be India's largest ever in rupee terms, and second largest in dollar terms, trailing the Hyundai Motors IPO that raised $3.3 billion in 2024.

zh.title: Meta和谷歌支持的Jio Platforms计划通过印度创纪录的IPO融资32亿美元
zh.summary: Meta和谷歌支持的Jio Platforms计划通过IPO融资最多32亿美元，这将是印度按卢比计最大、按美元计第二大的IPO。这次发行凸显了印度在全球资本市场中日益重要的地位，反映了投资者对印度数字经济的强烈信心。

title: SK Hynix shares plunge 10% amid Asia tech rout as Fed rate hike fears, AI funding worries mount
summary: SK Hynix shares fell 10% amid a broader Asian technology sector selloff fueled by concerns about Federal Reserve rate hikes and AI funding challenges. The decline reflects investor anxiety about whether rising borrowing costs could impair AI infrastructure investments and signals market concerns about the economics of continued AI expansion.
content: A sell-off in global technology hardware stocks deepened Thursday.

zh.title: 随着美联储加息担忧和人工智能融资忧虑增加，SK海力士股价在亚洲科技股下跌中暴跌10%
zh.summary: SK海力士股价下跌10%，这是由美联储加息担忧和人工智能融资挑战引发的亚洲科技股更广泛抛售的一部分。这一下跌反映了投资者对上升的借贷成本是否会削弱人工智能基础设施投资的担忧，也表明市场对持续人工智能扩张的经济效益感到担忧。

title: Anthropic’s slowing growth could be the AI trade’s latest red flag
summary: Anthropic's revenue growth appears to be decelerating as the company prepares for its public market debut. The slowdown is raising investor concerns about the sustainability of AI industry expansion and is being interpreted as a warning sign for the broader AI investment narrative.
content: Anthropic’s revenue growth appears to be cooling as the company prepares for its public debut, further stoking investors’ AI jitters

zh.title: Anthropic增长放缓可能是人工智能交易最新的警示信号
zh.summary: Anthropic在为上市做准备之际，其收入增长似乎在放缓。这一放缓正引发投资者对人工智能行业扩张可持续性的担忧，被解读为对更广泛人工智能投资叙事的警示信号。

title: Inside India newsletter: Billionaire Ambani’s mega-IPO faces a valuation reality check amid Musk spat
summary: Jio Platforms' planned IPO later this month is facing valuation challenges amid recent controversies involving Elon Musk. Billionaire Mukesh Ambani's company is navigating heightened media scrutiny as it prepares for its offering during an active geopolitical dispute.
content: Jio Platforms, the company at the center of Musk’s remarks, is launching an IPO later this month.

zh.title: 印度亿万富翁安巴尼的大型IPO在马斯克争执中面临估值现实检验
zh.summary: Jio Platforms计划本月晚些时候进行IPO,面临与埃隆·马斯克最近争议相关的估值挑战。亿万富翁穆克什·安巴尼的公司在准备发行时正应对媒体审视加强,因为正在进行激烈地缘政治争端。

title: Rocket Lab’s stock slides as the company pushes back Neutron’s first launch
summary: Rocket Lab's stock declined after the company announced a delay to the Neutron rocket's first launch, pushing it beyond 2026. Neutron is designed as a medium-lift competitor to SpaceX's Falcon 9, and the delay dampens near-term revenue expectations from the system.
content: Neutron, a medium-lift rocket meant to rival SpaceX’s Falcon 9, will no longer launch this year.

zh.title: 火箭实验室股价下滑,因公司推迟中子火箭首次发射
zh.summary: 火箭实验室公司宣布中子火箭首次发射延期至2026年之后,导致股价下跌。中子被设计为SpaceX猎鹰9号的中型运载火箭竞争者,延期打击了该系统的近期收入预期。
